title: woodsia × gracilis
intro: Woodsia × gracilis, commonly known as the hybrid woodsia fern, is a rare and unusual plant species resulting from the interspecific hybridization of the Woodsia ilvensis and Woodsia scopulina ferns. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Woodsia × gracilis include its ability to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as its role in promoting wound healing and antioxidant activity. Bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and may have additional benefits for cardiovascular health and immune system function.
